headline: Ansar Allah terrorist-designation call
dek: GCC Ministerial Council (Bahrain): condemned Iranian attacks on GCC states and Jordan, rejected Iran's justifications, demanded immediate unconditional cessation; condemned Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia in 'strongest terms'; called for Ansar Allah to be designated a 'terrorist group'; invoked Joint…
sources: GCC Ministerial Council statement via Al Jazeera liveblog; Lavrov at GCC meeting via Al Jazeera; Egypt presidency; Saudi civil defence (@SaudiDCD); Reuters (Egypt parliament MPs)
fault_line: Terrorist designation for the Ansar Allah — pressure that works, or a label that ends diplomacy?

sections.what_happened: GCC Ministerial Council (Bahrain): condemned Iranian attacks on GCC states and Jordan, rejected Iran's justifications, demanded immediate unconditional cessation; condemned Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia in 'strongest terms'; called for Ansar Allah to be designated a 'terrorist group'; invoked Joint Defence Agreement; demanded return of Hormuz conditions to pre-28 February; Egypt presidency: ready to give Saudi Arabia the support it needs; Egypt parliament postponed vote on authorising military support to Saudi Arabia to Monday; Lavrov at the meeting: called for US-Iran de-escalation, said Islamabad MoU contains everything needed; Saudi civil defence: projectile fell in Najran — 6 wounded, 3 houses + 3 vehicles damaged.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog entries 17:00-18:30 GMT; Reuters via MPs on Egypt vote postponement.
sections.what_disputed: GCC rejection of Iran's justifications is the Council's position, not independently verified fact; Najran casualty count from Saudi civil defence (single official source).
sections.why_matters: Side of truth: the Gulf's own council demands the attacks stop while Russia tells the room the US-Iran MoU already holds the off-ramp. Frame: 'Bahrain's message to Tehran, Lavrov's message to Washington.'
sections.context: Background: GCC Bahrain meeting: condemns Iran, demands halt; Ansar Allah terrorist-designation call; Egypt-Saudi support

totw_analysis: Our read: Side of truth: the Gulf's own council demands the attacks stop while Russia tells the room the US-Iran MoU already holds the off-ramp. Frame: 'Bahrain's message to Tehran, Lavrov's message to Washington.' The fault line our audience is arguing over: Terrorist designation for the Ansar Allah — pressure that works, or a label that ends diplomacy?
